summary: Iter 42 - Verified piutang pay-date routing & cair reminder. Backend 5/5 pytest passed: POS credit sale events on sale date only count initial amount_paid; /transactions/{id}/pay with explicit date moves pelunasan to that date with info 'Pelunasan piutang (transaksi <sale_date>)'; overpayment capped; amount<=0 => 400; total kas (no period) >= sum of per-month omzet_offline (no double counting); /api/ecommerce/belum-cair admin-only (kasir 403). Frontend: Hutang & Piutang piutang modal shows hp-pay-date defaulting to today, saving with custom date persists correctly ('payments[].date' honored); Hutang tab modal does NOT show hp-pay-date. Laba Rugi: cair-reminder visible when belum-cair exists with cair-reminder-count '1 pesanan Selesai belum dicatat cair'; cair-reminder-open opens cair-reminder-dialog with cair-reminder-row-{id} and CairCell (ecom-cair-open/date/nominal/save). After saving cair, row disappears and card switches to cair-reminder-done. Seeded data was cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 1079: payments[].date is stored as full ISO (e.g. '2097-04-20T18:39:04+00:00') built from `data.date[:10]`+current time; this is fine since cash_events slices [:10]. But if a client sends an ISO like '2097-04-20T...' then `data.date[:10]` still works. OK.

pay_transaction attributes payment to current server time-of-day on client-supplied date. Minor: consider storing just the YYYY-MM-DD for payments or including a separate 'at' timestamp like cair does, for clarity.

In HutangPiutang.jsx submitPay, when kind=='piutang' the request body is {amount, date} but if payDate is empty string the backend will treat as None (today). Guard against empty string in UI (currently default=todayStr(), so unlikely).
CairReminder.jsx line 46: `{list.length === 0}` is dead code — the component returns early when list is empty (line 17), so this empty-row never renders. Minor cleanup only.
